{{Quote|It is my function here to note all inventories, issue clearances, and keep all records.|[[LE-914]], an LE manifest droid|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 80">[[Star Wars (1977) 80|''Star Wars'' (1977) 80]]</ref>}}
A '''manifest droid''' was a variant of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] programmed with import-export restrictions for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major trading regions and the code of conduct imposed by the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], rather than etiquette and protocol. The [[LE manifest droid]] was a model of manifest [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]].<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
